Chennai is the auto manufacturing capital of India. Hyundai at Sriperumbudur, Renault-Nissan and Daimler at Oragadam, and the dense Tier-1 supplier ecosystem feeding them have built one of the country's largest industrial belts. Add the port-linked logistics economy and the constant factory construction across the city's western and southern corridors, and you have a market that needs container offices in serious volume — for site offices, plant administrative cabins, security posts, and logistics supervision rooms.

SAMAN manufactures steel container offices and supplies them across Chennai. We build at our own ISO-certified factory in Bangalore and dispatch directly to your Chennai site — Ambattur, Guindy, Sriperumbudur, the Oragadam SIPCOT corridor, and construction sites across the city. Transit from our factory to Chennai is typically 4 to 5 days.

We are the manufacturer, not a dealer reselling units. Explore the full range of container offices we build or call us with your requirement.

Why Chennai's Industrial Economy Needs Container Offices

A container office is a finished steel office unit — built from a refabricated shipping container or a new container-style steel frame — that arrives wired, insulated, and ready to use. No civil construction, no waiting for a permanent room. For Chennai's industrial buyers, that speed and mobility solves specific problems:

Auto plants and component suppliers at Oragadam, Sriperumbudur, and Ambattur use container offices as line supervisor cabins, quality-control rooms, and additional administrative space during capacity expansion. When a plant adds a production line, a container office gives the team a workspace in days, not months.

Construction and infrastructure contractors building factories, warehouses, and commercial projects across the Chennai metropolitan area need a project manager's site office and a security cabin at the entry. A container site office for construction projects is the standard solution.

Port and logistics operators along the Ennore and Chennai port corridors, and the warehousing belt toward Sriperumbudur, place container offices at yard entries for dispatch supervision and gate control.

Industrial estate units in Guindy and Ambattur use them as overflow offices and contractor coordination rooms.

Chennai's Industrial Zones — Where We Deliver

Telling us your delivery zone lets us plan the route and quote accurate freight. We deliver across Chennai, including:

Ambattur Industrial Estate (PIN 600058): One of South India's largest small-and-medium industrial estates, Ambattur hosts engineering, auto component, and manufacturing units. Container offices here serve as factory cabins, security posts, and site offices during unit expansion.

Guindy Industrial Estate (PIN 600032): Chennai's oldest industrial estate, centrally located, hosting engineering and manufacturing firms. Space is tight here, which makes a compact container office an efficient way to add a cabin without permanent construction.

Sriperumbudur (PIN 602105): The Hyundai-anchored auto and electronics manufacturing hub on the Chennai-Bangalore highway. Plant expansion and supplier setup here drive steady demand for site offices and security cabins.

Oragadam SIPCOT Industrial Corridor (PIN 603204): The Renault-Nissan and Daimler auto belt — one of India's most concentrated automotive manufacturing zones. Tier-1 supplier construction and plant expansion across Oragadam create consistent container office demand.

Outside these zones, we deliver to construction and logistics sites across the Chennai metropolitan area wherever a crane or forklift can place the unit.

Sizes and Specifications

Built to withstand a Chennai industrial site and the coastal climate.

Structure: Refabricated ISO shipping container OR new IS 2062 grade steel frame, anti-rust treated and painted

Insulation: PUF panel or rock wool lining — important in Chennai's hot, humid climate to keep the interior workable

Roofing: Container roof with extra weather sealing, or sloped GI over-roof for monsoon and coastal rain

Flooring: Marine plywood, vinyl, or anti-skid steel

Electrical: Wiring, MCB board, LED lights, fan and AC points to your declared load

Windows: Sliding glass with MS safety grille; mesh ventilation

Doors: Container door retained for storage-office combos, or MS/glass entry door

Common sizes for Chennai delivery:

SizeTypical use
10 ftSecurity cabin or single-desk office
20 ftStandard site office — most common
40 ftLarge office, or office + storage combination
20 ft + partitionOffice plus meeting or QC room
40 ft modularJoined units for larger workspace

Custom layouts and partitions are built to your site footprint.

Customisation — Built at Our Factory, Not Patched On-Site

  • Internal partition walls for separate rooms
  • Air conditioner provision — essential for Chennai's climate: cut-out, bracket, copper sleeve, drain
  • Upgraded insulation for direct-sun and coastal-exposure sites
  • Full electrical fit-out with MCB, sockets, LED, fan points
  • Insulated false ceiling for cooling efficiency
  • Attached toilet module with FRP tank and plumbing
  • Pantry counter for longer-stay site offices
  • Anti-corrosion treatment for coastal durability
  • Exterior paint and company branding panel

For auto-sector projects where the unit moves between plant areas, a mobile container office that relocates between sites is the right choice.

Why Buy From SAMAN

We manufacture our own container offices — most Chennai suppliers are dealers reselling units with a markup.

  • ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management (E20250218645)
  • ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management (E20250218646)
  • ISO 45001:2018 Occupational Health & Safety (E20250218647)
  • NSIC: NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207
  • DPIIT: DIPP56005
  • GST: 29ABBCS7101B1ZR

Structural frame warranty: 5 years. Finishing: 1–2 years. Engineered service life: 20–25 years. Over 500 projects since 2009.

For auto plants and industrial buyers who require vendor documentation for a quality audit or procurement file, we supply ISO certificate copies, NSIC registration, and GST papers with your order.

Price Factors

No fixed published price — every container office is built to specification. Cost depends on:

  • Converted shipping container vs new steel-frame build
  • Size (10 ft / 20 ft / 40 ft)
  • Insulation and climate-protection level
  • Electrical and AC fit-out
  • Partition, toilet, and pantry additions
  • Coastal anti-corrosion treatment

Freight from our Bangalore factory to Chennai (about 340 km via NH 44) is quoted as a separate line item. Send your size and use for a written quotation with full breakup within 24 hours.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the price of a container office in Chennai?

Price depends on size, whether it is a converted shipping container or a new steel-frame build, the insulation and AC fit-out, and any partition or toilet additions. A basic 20 ft unit costs less than a 40 ft fully-fitted office. Freight from our Bangalore factory to Chennai is added as a separate line. Call +91 88616 22859 with your requirement for a written quotation with full breakup within 24 hours.

Can you deliver a container office to Oragadam or Sriperumbudur auto plants?

Yes. We deliver to the Oragadam SIPCOT corridor (PIN 603204), Sriperumbudur (602105), Ambattur (600058), Guindy (600032), and all Chennai industrial and construction addresses. For auto plant and SIPCOT estate deliveries needing gate-pass authorisation, share the entry procedure when you order and we coordinate the delivery vehicle with your site.

How long does delivery take from Bangalore to Chennai?

Standard sizes are typically ready in 7–12 working days from order confirmation, with transit to Chennai of 4–5 days. Custom fit-out with AC, partition, and toilet adds a few working days to production. We confirm the dispatch and delivery dates in writing when you order.

Are your container offices suitable for Chennai's hot, humid coastal climate?

Yes. We use PUF or rock wool insulation as standard and apply anti-corrosion treatment to the steel. For coastal and direct-sun sites we recommend upgraded insulation, a heat-reflective over-roof, and AC provision. This keeps the interior workable through Chennai summers and protects the structure against humidity and salt air over its service life.

Call or Send an Enquiry

For a container office in Chennai — manufactured by SAMAN, delivered to your site:

+91 88616 22859 | +91 80886 85440

Call or WhatsApp. Same working day response. Include your size, use, and delivery zone for a complete quotation without a follow-up call.
